calmerge writes the merged calendar to stdout by default. `--out <file>` is the only way to write to a file. There is no default output file anymore.

**Why:** Changed by the user on 2026-11-02. The previous default of `./merged.ics` caused accidental overwrites when people ran it twice. Stdout matches Unix tool conventions. This supersedes the earlier `./merged.ics` default.

**How to apply:** When building or testing calmerge, expect the merged calendar on stdout unless `--out` is passed. Never reintroduce a default output file. Verify the flag still exists in the code before relying on it.
